item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00398","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C20","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.88,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied a material template because it combines the same core machinery used by the child: delegation of presidential land-related authority to the Secretary of the Interior, a concurrence requirement protecting another department's interests, and authorization for specified senior Interior officials to exercise the delegated authority. C20 is also structurally close through its Alaska-specific delegation and detailed redelegation provision, while C14 closely parallels the opening designation formula but lacks the child's additional administrative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate the Secretary of the Interior as my representative to exercise the authority vested in me by section 6(b) of the act","parent_excerpt":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Interior the authority vested in the President by section 1 of the act","explanation":"Both open by transferring a specifically cited presidential land-related authority to the Secretary of the Interior."},{"child_excerpt":"no selection by the State shall be approved pursuant to this order...without the concurrence of the Secretary of Defense or his designated representative","parent_excerpt":"No order affecting land under the administrative jurisdiction of any executive department or agency...shall be issued...without the prior approval or concurrence...of the head of the department or agency concerned, or of such officer...as the head thereof may designate","explanation":"Both condition the Secretary's exercise of land authority on concurrence by another department or its designated representative."},{"child_excerpt":"the Under Secretary of the Interior, an Assistant Secretary of the Interior, the Director of the Bureau of Land Management, or the Operations Supervisors...are severally authorized to exercise the authority vested in the Secretary by this order","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to redelegated the authority delegated to him by this order to...the Under Secretary of the Interior and the Assistant Secretaries of the Interior","explanation":"The child closely follows C01's redelegation structure and repeats two of its designated classes of Interior officers, while expanding the list to Bureau of Land Management officials."}]}
